text: Small noncanonical patches can carry core user-facing surfaces. The 0.18.124 health JSON patch had no queue-dev manifest root, so merge-plan aborted, but manual inspection showed it should be treated as core surface work: queue health --json/--fix/--deep under queuebash.health.v1. Preserve prior core-surface repairs and apply queuebash hunks by function semantics, not whole-file replacement.
